packages.base-files: Filesystem skeleton, users and /bin/sh that every system needs.
packages.bash: GNU Bourne Again Shell and the system's /bin/sh implementation.
packages.busybox: One static binary providing the shell, core, system and text utilities, DHCP client, ip and vi.
packages.ca-certificates: Mozilla CA bundle for TLS clients, installed as a file.
packages.console-login: Root login on the machine's serial console, whichever console the machine names.
packages.coreutils: Essential GNU file, text, and shell utilities.
packages.curl: URL transfer library and tool; git's HTTPS transport.
packages.dhcpcd: Small DHCP client used by the default network service.
packages.diffutils: GNU tools for comparing files and directories.
packages.findutils: GNU find, xargs, and file discovery tools.
packages.gawk: GNU implementation of the AWK text-processing language.
packages.gcc-runtime: GCC's target runtimes libgcc_s, libstdc++ and libatomic, copied from the pinned cross toolchain; the default cc-runtime and c++-runtime.
packages.git: Distributed version control, built with HTTPS support.
packages.glibc: GNU C library copied from the pinned cross toolchain sysroot: the guest loader, shared libraries, ldconfig and getent.
packages.gnulib: Source-only portability modules used during GNU package bootstrap; not installed in the guest.
packages.gzip: GNU gzip compression and decompression tools.
packages.host-share: Mounts the VM bundle's share at /mnt/shared over 9p; selected only on machines with a shared directory.
packages.iproute2: Linux network configuration and inspection utilities, including ip and ss.
packages.linux-libre: Deblobbed Linux kernel, built as an ordinary package graph node for both target platforms.
packages.llvm-runtime: LLVM's compiler-rt, libunwind, libc++ and libc++abi: the alternative cc-runtime and c++-runtime.
packages.musl: The musl C library, the libc of the linux-musl ABI.
packages.ncurses: Terminal handling library and terminfo database used by less.
packages.nodejs: Node.js runtime built from source at the same revision as the builder's node.
packages.openssh: OpenSSH sshd, ssh-keygen and clients, with the sshd privilege-separation account.
packages.openssl: OpenSSL 3.x TLS and crypto library linked by curl, git and OpenSSH.
packages.procps-ng: Process inspection tools such as ps, top, free, and uptime.
packages.runit: Init and service supervisor: stage scripts and the supervision of every package's services.
packages.tar: GNU archive creation and extraction utility.
packages.theia: Eclipse Theia browser IDE: offline npm build, plugins, and a service on port 3000.
packages.util-linux: Core Linux system utilities, terminals, mounts, and disk tools.
packages.vim: Tiny-feature Vim build for console editing.
packages.zlib: Compression library that curl, git and OpenSSH link.
packages.devbox: The devbox account setup: sshd with host keys on the state volume, the login profile, and the ssh-22 test.

metapackages.base: What boot itself uses: init, console login, shell, coreutils and util-linux.
metapackages.gnu-utils: The GNU text, file, archive and process tools: the default provider of utils.
metapackages.ide: Browser IDE served from the guest.
metapackages.reference-system: Complete userland matching the linux-libre-vm reference build.

platforms.arm64: ARMv8-A baseline software target with the GNU ABI and glibc.
platforms.armv6-bcm2835: ARMv6ZK/VFP software target for BCM2835 and ARM1176JZF-S machines.
platforms.x86_64: x86-64 baseline software target with the GNU ABI and glibc.

machines.qemu-virt-arm64: QEMU virt ARM64 machine with direct kernel boot and virtio devices.
machines.qemu-q35-x86_64: QEMU q35 x86-64 machine with direct kernel boot and virtio PCI devices.
machines.utm-virt-arm64: UTM 5 ARM64 virtual machine for Apple Silicon, using the QEMU backend with HVF, direct kernel boot, and an imported disk copy.
machines.utm-virt-arm64-8g: The UTM ARM64 machine with 2 vCPUs and 8 GiB of memory, for an IDE server.
machines.raspberry-pi-model-b-256mb: Physical Raspberry Pi Model B with BCM2835, 256 MiB of memory, 26-pin GPIO, and SD-card boot.
machines.raspberry-pi-model-b-512mb: Physical Raspberry Pi Model B with BCM2835, 512 MiB of memory, 26-pin GPIO, and SD-card boot.
machines.qemu-raspi1ap-armv6: QEMU ARMv6 BCM2835 target using raspi1ap; it models Raspberry Pi 1 Model A+, not Model B.
machines.utm-virt-arm64-devbox: The UTM ARM64 machine sized like linux-devbox-vm: 1 vCPU and 8 GiB of memory, for building and running Theia.

software.minimal-busybox: The minimal system with BusyBox as the shell and utilities.
software.minimal: The smallest bootable system: base only, a root shell on the serial console, stripped.
software.reference: The complete linux-libre-vm reference userland, for any compatible machine's platform.
software.theia: The reference system plus the Theia browser IDE, with /opt/theia on its own volume.
software.devbox: An analogue of linux-devbox-vm: SSH login as the host user, git, Node.js and the Theia IDE, with state kept across image replacement.
software.minimal-busybox-initramfs: minimal-busybox booted from RAM: the same closure in an initramfs, so it needs no disk image.

toolchains.linux-libre-vm: The builder image: cross toolchains by triplet, gcc (clang planned), and the tool manifest.

systems.qemu-arm64-reference: Reference composition of the QEMU virt ARM64 machine and the reference software.
systems.qemu-x86_64-reference: Reference composition of the QEMU q35 x86-64 machine and the reference software.
systems.utm-arm64-reference: Reference composition of the UTM ARM64 machine and the reference software for Apple Silicon hosts.
systems.utm-arm64-theia: The Theia IDE on an 8-GiB UTM ARM64 machine, with the workspace on the bundle share.
systems.qemu-arm64-minimal-busybox: The first system Eclogite builds and boots (M1): minimal BusyBox from an initramfs on the QEMU virt ARM64 machine.
systems.utm-arm64-devbox: The devbox on the UTM ARM64 devbox machine (M2).
